item.title: Could a Mileage Tax go through the state legislature?
item.description: The state legislature has been considering implementing a mileage tax to replace the gas tax for years now -- a law the Governor's press office says will never be signed into law.

item.title: Local activist, former campaign manager, recalls historic march with Rev. Jesse Jackson
item.description: 94-year-old Kathleen Harmon served as Jackson's San Diego campaign manager and joined his 1984 march to the Tijuana border promoting immigrant rights.

item.title: Fact or Fiction: White House Valentine's Day post says 'Daddy's Home' in candy hearts?
item.description: An image you may have seen on social media claims to show a post made by the White House on Valentine's Day of a candy heart that says ‘Daddy's Home.’
